- [**permissions_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.permissions_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable the permission system. Defaults to False.
- [**storage_type**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.storage_type) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The type of storage to use ("json", "sqlite", "msgpack", or "memory"). Defaults to "json".
- [**storage_path**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.storage_path) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The path to the storage file or directory. Defaults to "data".
- [**first_message_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.first_message_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable first message handling. Defaults to True.
- [**event_logging_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.event_logging_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable event logging. Defaults to True.
- [**max_logged_events**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.max_logged_events) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The maximum number of events to log. Defaults to 1000.
- [**event_middleware_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.event_middleware_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable event middleware. Defaults to True.
- [**announce_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.announce_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable bot announcements. Defaults to True.
- [**signature_verification_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.signature_verification_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable cryptographic signature verification for incoming messages. Defaults to False.
- [**require_message_signatures**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.require_message_signatures) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to reject unsigned messages when signature verification is enabled. Defaults to False.
- [**require_stamps**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.require_stamps) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to reject messages with invalid stamps. Defaults to False.
- [**request_unknown_identities**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.request_unknown_identities) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to request unknown identities from the network when a message is received from an unknown source. Defaults to False.
- [**stamp_cost**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.stamp_cost) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Stamp cost required for messages to this bot.
Outbound cost still comes from the peer announce unless send()
overrides it. None disables inbound stamps. Defaults to None.
- [**include_tickets**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.include_tickets) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Include reply tickets on outbound messages so
peers that require stamps can answer without stamp generation.
Defaults to True.
- [**direct_delivery_retries**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.direct_delivery_retries) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Number of times to retry direct delivery before falling back to propagation. Defaults to 3.
- [**propagation_fallback_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.propagation_fallback_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to use propagation nodes as fallback after direct delivery fails. Defaults to True.
- [**propagation_node**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.propagation_node) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash of the outbound propagation node. If None and autopeer_propagation is True, automatically discovers nodes. Defaults to None.
- [**autopeer_propagation**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.autopeer_propagation) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to automatically discover and peer with propagation nodes from announces. Defaults to False.
- [**autopeer_maxdepth**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.autopeer_maxdepth) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Maximum hop depth for auto-peering with propagation nodes. None = no limit. Defaults to 4.
- [**enable_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.enable_propagation_node) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to run this bot as a propagation node. Defaults to False.
- [**message_storage_limit_mb**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.message_storage_limit_mb) (<code>[float](#float)</code>) – Maximum storage for propagation node messages in megabytes. Only applies when enable_propagation_node is True. Defaults to 500 MB.
- [**config_path**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.config_path) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The path to the bot configuration directory. If None, defaults to "config" in the current working directory. Defaults to None.
- [**reticulum_config_dir**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.reticulum_config_dir) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The Reticulum config directory used for RNS shared instance/auth state. If None, uses LXMFY_RETICULUM_CONFIG_DIR when set, otherwise discovers the user/system Reticulum config (/etc/reticulum, ~/.config/reticulum, ~/.reticulum), and only then falls back to config_path. Isolated bot configs force share_instance=No to avoid RPC digest rejection with NomadNet/Columba.
- [**test_mode**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.test_mode) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to run in test mode (skips RNS initialization). Defaults to False.
- [**log_level**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.log_level) (<code>[str](#str) or [int](#int) or None</code>) – Logging level for lxmfy's own logger ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", ...). None leaves logging untouched. Defaults to "INFO".
- [**loglevel**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.loglevel) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – RNS log level (0-7) passed to RNS.Reticulum. None uses the Reticulum config file setting. Defaults to None.
- [**pending_sends_enabled**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.pending_sends_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Hold outbound messages when the destination identity is not yet known, retrying on announces and periodic sweeps. Defaults to True.
- [**pending_sends_max**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.pending_sends_max) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Maximum deferred messages kept for unknown destinations. Oldest are dropped beyond this. Defaults to 200.
- [**pending_sends_ttl**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.pending_sends_ttl) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Seconds a deferred message is kept before being dropped. Defaults to 604800 (7 days).
- [**pending_sends_retry**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.pending_sends_retry) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Minimum seconds between deferred-send sweeps in run(). Defaults to 300.
- [**announce_display_name_file**](#lxmfy.BotConfig.announce_display_name_file) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – Optional filename under config_path whose UTF-8 contents override the bot display name for LXMF delivery announces. If unset, ``bot_display_name.txt`` is read when present. Otherwise ``name`` is used.

### `lxmfy.Command`

```python
Command(name, description='No description provided', admin_only=False, permissions=None, usage=None, examples=None, category=None, aliases=None, threaded=False, rate_limit=None)
```

A decorator class for bot commands.

This class is used to mark methods as bot commands and provide metadata
about the command such as its name, description, and permission requirements.

**Attributes:**

- [**name**](#lxmfy.Command.name) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the command
- [**description**](#lxmfy.Command.description) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – A description of what the command does
- [**admin_only**](#lxmfy.Command.admin_only) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether the command is restricted to admin users
- [**callback**](#lxmfy.Command.callback) (<code>[callable](#callable)</code>) – The function that implements the command

**Parameters:**

- **name** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the command
- **description** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – Description of the command. Defaults to "No description provided"
- **admin_only** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether the command requires admin privileges. Defaults to False
- **rate_limit** (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Max invocations per sender per
cooldown window for this command. None disables the
per-command limit; the global message rate limit still
applies.

#### `lxmfy.Command.admin_only`

```python
admin_only = admin_only
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.callback`

```python
callback = None
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.description`

```python
description = description
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.help`

```python
help = CommandHelp(name=name, description=description, usage=usage, examples=examples or [], category=category, aliases=aliases or [])
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.name`

```python
name = name
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.permissions`

```python
permissions = permissions or (DefaultPerms.ALL if admin_only else DefaultPerms.USE_COMMANDS)
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.rate_limit`

```python
rate_limit = rate_limit
```

#### `lxmfy.Command.threaded`

```python
threaded = threaded
```

### `lxmfy.ConversationManager`

```python
ConversationManager(bot)
```

Tracks pending questions per sender and resolves them on reply.

**Functions:**

- [**ask**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask) – Send a prompt and block until the sender replies.
- [**ask_async**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask_async) – Send a prompt and await the sender's reply.
- [**ask_callback**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask_callback) – Send a prompt and invoke on_answer(answer) when the reply arrives.
- [**cancel**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.cancel) – Cancel a pending question for a sender.
- [**cancel_all**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.cancel_all) – Cancel every pending question.
- [**has_pending**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.has_pending) – True when a question is waiting on this sender.
- [**pending_count**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.pending_count) – Number of senders with a pending question.
- [**pending_senders**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.pending_senders) – Senders with a pending question.
- [**resolve**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.resolve) – Feed an inbound message to a pending question.

**Attributes:**

- [**bot**](#lxmfy.ConversationManager.bot) – 

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask`

```python
ask(sender, prompt, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None)
```

Send a prompt and block until the sender replies.

Returns an Answer with content, fields, and hash, or None on
timeout or cancellation. In async command handlers use
``await msg.ask_async(...)`` instead. For long waits prefer the
callback style with ``on_answer`` so no thread stays parked.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask_async`

```python
ask_async(sender, prompt, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None)
```

Send a prompt and await the sender's reply.

Same contract as ask, for async command handlers.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.ask_callback`

```python
ask_callback(sender, prompt, on_answer, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None, on_timeout=None)
```

Send a prompt and invoke on_answer(answer) when the reply arrives.

Non-blocking. on_timeout(sender) fires if the sender never
answers. Returns False when the pending limit is reached.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.bot`

```python
bot = bot
```

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.cancel`

```python
cancel(sender)
```

Cancel a pending question for a sender.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.cancel_all`

```python
cancel_all()
```

Cancel every pending question.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.has_pending`

```python
has_pending(sender)
```

True when a question is waiting on this sender.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.pending_count`

```python
pending_count()
```

Number of senders with a pending question.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.pending_senders`

```python
pending_senders()
```

Senders with a pending question.

#### `lxmfy.ConversationManager.resolve`

```python
resolve(sender, message)
```

Feed an inbound message to a pending question.

Returns True when the message was consumed as an answer. When a
validator rejects the answer the question stays pending.

```python
DEFAULT_DEST_NAME = 'rrc.hub'
```

### `lxmfy.Debugger`

```python
Debugger(*, reticulum_config_dir=None, config_path=None, bot=None, privacy=True)
```

Diagnose LXMF send/receive connectivity problems.

**Functions:**

- [**check_announce**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_announce) – Announce configuration and optional live announce test.
- [**check_bot_identity**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_bot_identity) – Report bot delivery destination if available.
- [**check_delivery_config**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_delivery_config) – Report effective delivery knobs (bot config or framework defaults).
- [**check_delivery_timeline**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_delivery_timeline) – Render recent delivery events from the live bot or disk.
- [**check_disk_permissions**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_disk_permissions) – Verify config, storage, and Reticulum dirs are usable.
- [**check_environment**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_environment) – OS, Python, and package versions.
- [**check_instance**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_instance) – Shared RNS instance vs owned/isolated bot config.
- [**check_interfaces**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_interfaces) – Report Reticulum interface status (no hostnames/IPs).
- [**check_send_pipeline**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_send_pipeline) – Internal reasons messages would or would not leave the bot.
- [**check_storage_history**](#lxmfy.Debugger.check_storage_history) – Read delivery_attempts / persisted_queue from disk without a live bot.
- [**compare_destinations**](#lxmfy.Debugger.compare_destinations) – Compare path/identity status for two destination hashes.
- [**diagnose_receive**](#lxmfy.Debugger.diagnose_receive) – Explain why peers may not be able to reach this bot.
- [**diagnose_send**](#lxmfy.Debugger.diagnose_send) – Explain why sending to a destination may fail.
- [**ensure_reticulum**](#lxmfy.Debugger.ensure_reticulum) – Initialize Reticulum if needed.
- [**format_report_text**](#lxmfy.Debugger.format_report_text) – Format a plain-text privacy-friendly report for files/sharing.
- [**print_probe**](#lxmfy.Debugger.print_probe) – Print a destination probe result.
- [**print_report**](#lxmfy.Debugger.print_report) – Print a doctor report to the terminal.
- [**probe_destination**](#lxmfy.Debugger.probe_destination) – Probe path and identity knowledge for a destination.
- [**run_doctor**](#lxmfy.Debugger.run_doctor) – Run a full connectivity doctor report.
- [**save_report**](#lxmfy.Debugger.save_report) – Write report to a file and return the path used.

**Attributes:**

- [**bot**](#lxmfy.Debugger.bot) – 
- [**config_path**](#lxmfy.Debugger.config_path) – 
- [**privacy**](#lxmfy.Debugger.privacy) – 
- [**reticulum_config_dir**](#lxmfy.Debugger.reticulum_config_dir) – 

**Parameters:**

- **reticulum_config_dir** (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Explicit Reticulum config directory.
- **config_path** (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Bot config directory (identity, announce state).
- **bot** (<code>[Any](#typing.Any) | None</code>) – Optional running LXMFBot instance to introspect.
- **privacy** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Redact paths/hashes in reports (default True).

### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker`

```python
DeliveryTracker(storage=None, maxlen=500)
```

Bounded delivery event stream with subscribers and persistence.

**Functions:**

- [**load_persisted**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.load_persisted) – Restore the persisted tail into memory at startup.
- [**recent**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.recent) – Return the most recent events, oldest first.
- [**record**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.record) – Append a delivery event and notify subscribers.
- [**subscribe**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.subscribe) – Register a subscriber called with each new event dict.
- [**unsubscribe**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.unsubscribe) – Remove a subscriber. Returns True when it was registered.

**Attributes:**

- [**events**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.events) (<code>[deque](#collections.deque)[[dict](#dict)[[str](#str), [Any](#typing.Any)]]</code>) – 
- [**subscribers**](#lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.subscribers) (<code>[list](#list)[[Callable](#collections.abc.Callable)]</code>) – 

**Parameters:**

- **storage** – Optional Storage facade for persisting the recent
tail of the stream. Pass None to keep events in memory.
- **maxlen** (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Maximum in-memory events retained.

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.events`

```python
events: deque[dict[str, Any]] = deque(maxlen=maxlen)
```

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.load_persisted`

```python

```

Restore the persisted tail into memory at startup.

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.recent`

```python
recent(limit=None, *, stage=None, destination=None)
```

Return the most recent events, oldest first.

**Parameters:**

- **limit** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Maximum events returned, counted from the newest.
- **stage** (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Optional stage filter.
- **destination** (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Optional exact destination filter.

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.record`

```python
record(stage, **fields)
```

Append a delivery event and notify subscribers.

**Parameters:**

- **stage** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – One of STAGES.
- ****fields** – Optional event fields: destination, message_id,
hash, method, attempts, reason, title.

**Returns:**

- <code>[dict](#dict)[[str](#str), [Any](#typing.Any)]</code> – The recorded event dict.

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.subscribe`

```python

```

Register a subscriber called with each new event dict.

#### `lxmfy.DeliveryTracker.subscribers`

```python
subscribers: list[Callable] = []
```

```python

```

### `lxmfy.LXMFBot`

```python
LXMFBot(name=None, **kwargs)
```

Bases: <code>[AnnounceMixin](#lxmfy._announcing.AnnounceMixin)</code>, <code>[DispatchMixin](#lxmfy._dispatch.DispatchMixin)</code>, <code>[CogMixin](#lxmfy._cogs.CogMixin)</code>, <code>[InboundMixin](#lxmfy._inbound.InboundMixin)</code>, <code>[OutboundMixin](#lxmfy._outbound.OutboundMixin)</code>, <code>[LinkMixin](#lxmfy._links.LinkMixin)</code>, <code>[RRCMixin](#lxmfy._rrc.RRCMixin)</code>, <code>[PropagationMixin](#lxmfy._propagation.PropagationMixin)</code>

Main bot class for handling LXMF messages and commands.

This class manages the bot's lifecycle, including:
- Message routing and delivery
- Command registration and execution
- Cog (extension) loading and management
- Spam protection
- Admin privileges

**Functions:**

- [**add_cog**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.add_cog) – Add a cog to the bot.
- [**allow_control_identity**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.allow_control_identity) – Allow an identity to issue control requests to this node.
- [**allow_destination**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.allow_destination) – Add an identity to the router allow list.
- [**announce_now**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.announce_now) – Send an LXMF delivery announce using the current display name.
- [**announce_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.announce_propagation_node) – Announce this node as a propagation node.
- [**cancel_all_inbound**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.cancel_all_inbound) – Cancel all active inbound resource transfers.
- [**cancel_inbound**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.cancel_inbound) – Cancel an active inbound resource transfer by its hash.
- [**cancel_outbound**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.cancel_outbound) – Cancel a pending outbound message by its message_id.
- [**cancel_propagation_sync**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.cancel_propagation_sync) – Tear down an in-progress propagation node sync.
- [**cleanup**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.cleanup) – Clean up resources.
- [**command**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.command) – Decorator for registering commands.
- [**connect_rrc**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.connect_rrc) – Connect to an RRC hub as a client.
- [**delivery_link_available**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.delivery_link_available) – Check whether a direct link is up for a destination.
- [**diagnose_connectivity**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.diagnose_connectivity) – Run a connectivity doctor report for this bot.
- [**diagnose_destination**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.diagnose_destination) – Probe path and identity for a destination hash.
- [**disallow_control_identity**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.disallow_control_identity) – Revoke control request access for an identity.
- [**disallow_destination**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.disallow_destination) – Remove an identity from the router allow list.
- [**disconnect_rrc**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.disconnect_rrc) – Disconnect one or all RRC hub sessions.
- [**enforce_stamps**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.enforce_stamps) – Enforce stamp requirements for inbound deliveries.
- [**generate_ticket**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.generate_ticket) – Generate an LXMF ticket that lets a destination bypass stamp costs.
- [**get_debugger**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_debugger) – Return a Debugger bound to this bot.
- [**get_inbound_tickets**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_inbound_tickets) – List valid inbound tickets held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_landlock_status**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_landlock_status) – Return Landlock LSM sandbox availability and activation state.
- [**get_outbound_progress**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_outbound_progress) – Get transfer progress (0.0-1.0) for a pending outbound LXM.
- [**get_outbound_stamp_cost**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_outbound_stamp_cost) – Get the stamp cost a destination announced it requires, or None.
- [**get_outbound_ticket**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_outbound_ticket) – Get a valid outbound ticket held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_outbound_ticket_expiry**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_outbound_ticket_expiry) – Get the expiry timestamp of the outbound ticket for a destination.
- [**get_peer_announce**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_announce) – Return announce metadata held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_peer_app_data**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_app_data) – Recall the app_data a destination last announced, or None.
- [**get_peer_lxmf_data**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_lxmf_data) – Decode an LXMF peer's announced metadata, or None.
- [**get_propagation_node_status**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_propagation_node_status) – Get information about configured and discovered propagation nodes.
- [**get_propagation_stats**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_propagation_stats) – Compile propagation node statistics.
- [**get_propagation_storage_stats**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_propagation_storage_stats) – Get storage statistics for propagation node mode.
- [**has_message**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.has_message) – Check whether an inbound LXM hash was already delivered.
- [**ignore_destination**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.ignore_destination) – Silently drop all inbound LXMF traffic from a destination.
- [**ignore_stamps**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.ignore_stamps) – Disable stamp enforcement for inbound deliveries.
- [**inbound_count**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.inbound_count) – Number of inbound resource transfers currently in progress.
- [**inbound_transfers**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.inbound_transfers) – Snapshot active inbound resource transfers.
- [**ingest_lxm_uri**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.ingest_lxm_uri) – Import an LXM from an lxm:// URI as if it arrived off the wire.
- [**intent**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.intent) – Decorator for registering intent handlers.
- [**is_admin**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.is_admin) – Check if a sender is an admin.
- [**is_ignored**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.is_ignored) – Check whether inbound traffic from a destination is dropped.
- [**list_peer_announces**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.list_peer_announces) – List destinations whose announces this node has heard.
- [**load_extension**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.load_extension) – Load an extension (cog) by name.
- [**on_delivery_event**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.on_delivery_event) – Subscribe to the outbound delivery event stream.

- [**set_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.set_propagation_node) – Manually set the outbound propagation node.

- [**unprioritise_destination**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.unprioritise_destination) – Remove a destination from the prioritised list.
- [**validate**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.validate) – Run validation checks and return formatted results.

- [**spam_protection**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.spam_protection) – 
- [**storage**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.storage) – 
- [**thread_pool**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.thread_pool) – 
- [**transport**](#lxmfy.LXMFBot.transport) – 

**Parameters:**

- **name** (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Optional bot name, same as the name config key.
- ****kwargs** (<code>[Any](#typing.Any)</code>) – Override default configuration settings

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.allow_control_identity`

```python
allow_control_identity(destination)
```

Allow an identity to issue control requests to this node.

Control requests include peer sync and unpeer operations on a
propagation node. Returns False on an invalid hash.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.allow_destination`

```python
allow_destination(destination)
```

Add an identity to the router allow list.

When the allow list is non-empty, LXMF only accepts deliveries
from listed identities. Returns False on an invalid hash.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.announce_enabled`

```python
announce_enabled = self.config.announce_enabled
```

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.announce_now`

```python
announce_now(force=False)
```

Send an LXMF delivery announce using the current display name.

LXMF builds delivery announce app_data from the destination display name
at announce time; this method refreshes that from :attr:`name`, optional
``announce_display_name_file``, or ``bot_display_name.txt`` before
sending.

**Parameters:**

- **force** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – If True, send now and skip the on-disk announce interval
throttle (still respects ``announce_enabled`` and requires a
running router). If False, behave like the periodic announce
task (honours ``announce_time`` and the throttle file).

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.announce_propagation_node`

```python
announce_propagation_node()
```

Announce this node as a propagation node.

Returns False unless the router is running with propagation
enabled, since the announce requires the propagation destination.

```python
announce_time = self.config.announce
```

Operates on the list directly because LXMRouter.disallow pops by

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.generate_ticket`

```python
generate_ticket(destination, expiry=None)
```

Generate an LXMF ticket that lets a destination bypass stamp costs.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash the ticket is valid for.
- **expiry** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Seconds until expiry. None uses the LXMF default.

Returns a dict with expires and ticket keys, or None when a valid
ticket was recently delivered or the hash is invalid.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_announce`

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_app_data`

```python
get_peer_app_data(destination)
```

Recall the app_data a destination last announced, or None.

App data is whatever the announcing app attached to its announce.
LXMF delivery announces carry the peer display name; other apps
publish their own metadata.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.get_peer_lxmf_data`

```python
get_peer_lxmf_data(destination)
```

Decode an LXMF peer's announced metadata, or None.

LXMF delivery announces pack app_data as msgpack:
[display_name, stamp_cost, supported_functionality]. Returns a
dict with those keys when the peer announced a valid LXMF entry.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.react`

```python
react(destination, message_hash, reaction)
```

Send a reaction to a message.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash of the message author.
- **message_hash** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The full LXMessage hash being reacted to, hex.
- **reaction** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The reaction content, usually a single emoji.

Reactions travel as an LXMF FIELD_REACTION dict on an otherwise
empty message. Clients that understand the field attach it to the
target message; clients that do not see a short empty delivery.

#### `lxmfy.LXMFBot.sync_propagation_node`

```python
sync_propagation_node(max_messages=None)
```

Request stored messages from the outbound propagation node.

Establishes a link to the configured propagation node if needed
and downloads messages held for this bot's identity. Delivery
completes asynchronously through the normal inbound pipeline.

**Parameters:**

- **max_messages** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Maximum messages to request. None requests all.

Returns False when no router, identity, or outbound propagation
node is configured.

### `lxmfy.MiddlewareManager`

```python
MiddlewareManager()
```

Manages middleware registration and execution

**Functions:**

- [**execute**](#lxmfy.MiddlewareManager.execute) – Execute middleware chain for given type
- [**register**](#lxmfy.MiddlewareManager.register) – Register a middleware function

### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage`

```python
MsgPackStorage(directory)
```

Bases: <code>[StorageBackend](#lxmfy.storage.StorageBackend)</code>

MsgPack file-based storage backend.

Uses the msgpack implementation vendored with RNS
(``RNS.vendor.umsgpack``), so no extra dependency is needed. Stores
each key in its own ``{key}.msgpack`` file, mirroring JSONStorage.

**Functions:**

- [**delete**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.delete) – Delete a value from storage.
- [**exists**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.exists) – Check if a key exists in storage.
- [**get**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.get) – Retrieve a value from storage.
- [**scan**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.scan) – Scan for keys with a given prefix.
- [**set**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.set) – Store a value in storage.

**Attributes:**

- [**cache**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.cache) (<code>[dict](#dict)[[str](#str), [Any](#typing.Any)]</code>) – 
- [**directory**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.directory) – 
- [**logger**](#lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.logger) – 

**Parameters:**

- **directory** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The directory to store the msgpack files in.

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.cache`

```python
cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
```

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.delete`

```python
delete(key)
```

Delete a value from storage.

**Parameters:**

- **key** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The key to delete.

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.directory`

```python
directory = Path(directory)
```

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.exists`

```python
exists(key)
```

Check if a key exists in storage.

**Parameters:**

- **key** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The key to check.

**Returns:**

- <code>[bool](#bool)</code> – True if the key exists, False otherwise.

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.get`

```python
get(key, default=None)
```

Retrieve a value from storage.

**Parameters:**

- **key** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The key to retrieve.
- **default** (<code>[Any](#typing.Any)</code>) – The default value to return if the key is not found.

**Returns:**

- <code>[Any](#typing.Any)</code> – The value associated with the key, or the default value if not found.

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.logger`

```python
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
```

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.scan`

```python
scan(prefix)
```

Scan for keys with a given prefix.

**Parameters:**

- **prefix** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The prefix to scan for.

**Returns:**

- <code>[list](#list)</code> – A list of keys that start with the prefix.

#### `lxmfy.MsgPackStorage.set`

```python
set(key, value)
```

Store a value in storage.

**Parameters:**

- **key** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The key to store the value under.
- **value** (<code>[Any](#typing.Any)</code>) – The value to store.

### `lxmfy.RRCClient`

```python
RRCClient(identity, hub_hash, dest_name=DEFAULT_DEST_NAME, nick=None, auto_reconnect=True, client_name=CLIENT_NAME, client_version=CLIENT_VERSION, on_event=None)
```

Client session for a single RRC hub destination.

**Functions:**

- [**connect**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.connect) – Begin connecting to the hub in a background thread.
- [**disconnect**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.disconnect) – Tear down the session and cancel reconnect.
- [**join**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.join) – Request membership in a room. Returns the normalized room name.
- [**part**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.part) – Leave a room. Returns the normalized room name.
- [**ping**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.ping) – Send a PING and return the correlation body.
- [**send_action**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.send_action) – Send an ACTION to a room. Returns the message id.
- [**send_command**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.send_command) – Send a slash command as a MSG body.
- [**send_message**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.send_message) – Send a MSG to a room. Returns the message id.
- [**send_notice**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.send_notice) – Send a NOTICE to a room. Returns the message id.
- [**set_auto_join**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.set_auto_join) – Configure rooms to join automatically after WELCOME.
- [**set_nick**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.set_nick) – Set the advisory nickname used on outgoing envelopes.
- [**status_dict**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.status_dict) – Return a serializable status snapshot.

**Attributes:**

- [**CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S) – 
- [**HELLO_ATTEMPTS**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.HELLO_ATTEMPTS) – 
- [**HELLO_INTERVAL_S**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.HELLO_INTERVAL_S) –

- [**dest_name**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.dest_name) – 
- [**hub_caps**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.hub_caps) (<code>[dict](#dict)</code>) – 
- [**hub_hash**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.hub_hash) – 
- [**hub_name**](#lxmfy.RRCClient.hub_name) (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) –

### `lxmfy.RRCManager`

```python
RRCManager(identity=None, nick=None, dest_name=DEFAULT_DEST_NAME, auto_reconnect=True, storage=None, persist_sessions=False)
```

Owns RRCClient sessions and fans events out to bot handlers.

**Functions:**

- [**connect**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.connect) – Connect to an RRC hub. Returns the client session.
- [**disconnect**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.disconnect) – Disconnect one hub, or all hubs when hub_hash is None.
- [**get**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.get) – Return a connected client for a hub hash, if present.
- [**join**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.join) – Join a room on the first connected hub, or a specific hub.
- [**on_event**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.on_event) – Register an event callback. Returns the callback for decorator use.
- [**part**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.part) – Part a room on the first connected hub, or a specific hub.
- [**restore_sessions**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.restore_sessions) – Restore persisted hub sessions. Returns number of hubs reconnected.
- [**save_sessions**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.save_sessions) – Persist hub hashes, rooms, and nick for crash recovery.
- [**send_action**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.send_action) – Send an ACTION on the first connected hub, or a specific hub.
- [**send_message**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.send_message) – Send a MSG on the first connected hub, or a specific hub.
- [**send_notice**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.send_notice) – Send a NOTICE on the first connected hub, or a specific hub.
- [**shutdown**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.shutdown) – Persist session state and tear down links without forgetting hubs.
- [**status**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.status) – Return status snapshots for all hub sessions.

**Attributes:**

- [**STORAGE_KEY**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.STORAGE_KEY) – 
- [**auto_reconnect**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.auto_reconnect) – 
- [**clients**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.clients) (<code>[dict](#dict)[[bytes](#bytes), [RRCClient](#lxmfy.rrc.client.RRCClient)]</code>) – 
- [**dest_name**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.dest_name) – 
- [**identity**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.identity) – 
- [**nick**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.nick) – 
- [**persist_sessions**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.persist_sessions) – 
- [**storage**](#lxmfy.RRCManager.storage) – 

#### `lxmfy.RRCManager.STORAGE_KEY`

### `lxmfy.Role`

```python
Role(name, permissions, priority=0, description=None)
```

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.allow_control_identity`

```python
allow_control_identity(destination)
```

Allow an identity to issue control requests to this node.

Control requests include peer sync and unpeer operations on a
propagation node. Returns False on an invalid hash.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.allow_destination`

```python
allow_destination(destination)
```

Add an identity to the router allow list.

When the allow list is non-empty, LXMF only accepts deliveries
from listed identities. Returns False on an invalid hash.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.announce_enabled`

```python
announce_enabled = self.config.announce_enabled
```

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.announce_now`

```python
announce_now(force=False)
```

Send an LXMF delivery announce using the current display name.

LXMF builds delivery announce app_data from the destination display name
at announce time; this method refreshes that from :attr:`name`, optional
``announce_display_name_file``, or ``bot_display_name.txt`` before
sending.

**Parameters:**

- **force** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – If True, send now and skip the on-disk announce interval
throttle (still respects ``announce_enabled`` and requires a
running router). If False, behave like the periodic announce
task (honours ``announce_time`` and the throttle file).

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.announce_propagation_node`

```python
announce_propagation_node()
```

Generate an LXMF ticket that lets a destination bypass stamp costs.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.get_peer_app_data`

```python

```

App data is whatever the announcing app attached to its announce.
LXMF delivery announces carry the peer display name; other apps
publish their own metadata.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.get_peer_lxmf_data`

```python
get_peer_lxmf_data(destination)
```

Decode an LXMF peer's announced metadata, or None.

LXMF delivery announces pack app_data as msgpack:
[display_name, stamp_cost, supported_functionality]. Returns a
dict with those keys when the peer announced a valid LXMF entry.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.react`

```python
react(destination, message_hash, reaction)
```

Send a reaction to a message.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash of the message author.
- **message_hash** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The full LXMessage hash being reacted to, hex.
- **reaction** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The reaction content, usually a single emoji.

Reactions travel as an LXMF FIELD_REACTION dict on an otherwise
empty message. Clients that understand the field attach it to the
target message; clients that do not see a short empty delivery.

#### `lxmfy.TestBot.sync_propagation_node`

```python

```

and downloads messages held for this bot's identity. Delivery
completes asynchronously through the normal inbound pipeline.

**Parameters:**

node is configured.

### `lxmfy.attachments`

**Classes:**

- [**Attachment**](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment) – Represents a generic attachment.
- [**AttachmentType**](#lxmfy.attachments.AttachmentType) – Enumerates the different types of attachments supported.
- [**IconAppearance**](#lxmfy.attachments.IconAppearance) – Represents LXMF icon appearance data.

**Functions:**

- [**create_audio_attachment**](#lxmfy.attachments.create_audio_attachment) – Create an audio attachment list.
- [**create_file_attachment**](#lxmfy.attachments.create_file_attachment) – Create a file attachment list.
- [**create_image_attachment**](#lxmfy.attachments.create_image_attachment) – Create an image attachment list.
- [**pack_attachment**](#lxmfy.attachments.pack_attachment) – Packs an Attachment object into a dictionary suitable for LXMF transmission.
- [**pack_icon_appearance_field**](#lxmfy.attachments.pack_icon_appearance_field) – Packs an IconAppearance object into a dictionary suitable for LXMF transmission.

#### `lxmfy.attachments.Attachment`

```python
Attachment(type, name, data, format=None)
```

Represents a generic attachment.

**Attributes:**

- [**type**](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment.type) (<code>[AttachmentType](#lxmfy.attachments.AttachmentType)</code>) – The type of the attachment (AttachmentType).
- [**name**](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment.name) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the attachment.
- [**data**](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment.data) (<code>[bytes](#bytes)</code>) – The binary data of the attachment.
- [**format**](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment.format) (<code>[str](#str) | None</code>) – Optional format specifier (e.g., "png" for images).

##### `lxmfy.attachments.Attachment.data`

```python
data: bytes
```


### `lxmfy.cli`

CLI module for LXMFy bot framework.

Provides an interactive and colorful command-line interface for creating and managing LXMF bots,
including bot file creation and example cog generation.

**Functions:**

- [**create_bot_file**](#lxmfy.cli.create_bot_file) – Creates a new bot file from a template.
- [**create_example_cog**](#lxmfy.cli.create_example_cog) – Creates an example cog and the necessary directory structure.
- [**create_from_template**](#lxmfy.cli.create_from_template) – Creates a bot from a template.
- [**get_bot_name**](#lxmfy.cli.get_bot_name) – Get bot name from user input.
- [**get_template_choice**](#lxmfy.cli.get_template_choice) – Get template choice from user input.
- [**get_user_choice**](#lxmfy.cli.get_user_choice) – Get user's choice from the menu.
- [**interactive_create**](#lxmfy.cli.interactive_create) – Interactive bot creation process.
- [**interactive_debug**](#lxmfy.cli.interactive_debug) – Interactive debugger.
- [**interactive_mode**](#lxmfy.cli.interactive_mode) – Run the CLI in interactive mode.
- [**interactive_run**](#lxmfy.cli.interactive_run) – Interactive bot running process.
- [**is_safe_path**](#lxmfy.cli.is_safe_path) – Checks if a path is safe and within the allowed directory.
- [**main**](#lxmfy.cli.main) – Main CLI entry point.
- [**run_debug_command**](#lxmfy.cli.run_debug_command) – Run the debugger CLI.
- [**run_init**](#lxmfy.cli.run_init) – Interactive project scaffold.
- [**sanitize_filename**](#lxmfy.cli.sanitize_filename) – Sanitizes the filename while preserving the extension.
- [**validate_bot_name**](#lxmfy.cli.validate_bot_name) – Validates and sanitizes a bot name.

### `lxmfy.cogs_core`

Cogs management module for LXMFy.

This module provides functionality for loading and managing cogs (extension modules)
in LXMFy bots. It handles dynamic loading of Python modules from a specified directory
and manages their integration with the bot system.

### `lxmfy.colors`

Color support module for LXMFy CLI.

Provides cross-platform color support for terminal output.
Honours NO_COLOR / FORCE_COLOR, skips ANSI when not a TTY, and enables
Windows Virtual Terminal Processing when available (modern Windows Terminal,
PowerShell, and CMD). Classic consoles without VT fall back to plain text.

**Classes:**

- [**Colors**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors) – ANSI color codes for terminal output.

**Functions:**

- [**init_colors**](#lxmfy.colors.init_colors) – Initialize color support for the current platform.
- [**print_check**](#lxmfy.colors.print_check) – Print a diagnostic check result.
- [**print_dim**](#lxmfy.colors.print_dim) – Print a dimmed / secondary detail line.
- [**print_error**](#lxmfy.colors.print_error) – Print an error message with custom styling.
- [**print_header**](#lxmfy.colors.print_header) – Print a formatted header with custom styling.
- [**print_info**](#lxmfy.colors.print_info) – Print an info message with custom styling.
- [**print_kv**](#lxmfy.colors.print_kv) – Print a key/value diagnostic line.
- [**print_menu**](#lxmfy.colors.print_menu) – Print the interactive menu.
- [**print_section**](#lxmfy.colors.print_section) – Print a section title.
- [**print_success**](#lxmfy.colors.print_success) – Print a success message with custom styling.
- [**print_warning**](#lxmfy.colors.print_warning) – Print a warning message with custom styling.

#### `lxmfy.colors.Colors`

ANSI color codes for terminal output.

Automatically handles Windows Virtual Terminal Processing initialization.

**Functions:**

- [**colorize**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.colorize) – Apply color codes to text if colors are supported.
- [**enable_windows_colors**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.enable_windows_colors) – Enable ANSI color support on Windows 10/11.
- [**is_colors_supported**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.is_colors_supported) – Check if colors are supported in the current environment.
- [**reset**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.reset) – Clear cached color support state (for tests and --no-color).
- [**set_enabled**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.set_enabled) – Force colors on or off, overriding auto-detection.
- [**strip_colors**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.strip_colors) – Remove ANSI color codes from text.

**Attributes:**

- [**BLUE**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.BLUE) – 
- [**BOLD**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.BOLD) – 
- [**CYAN**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.CYAN) – 
- [**DIM**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.DIM) –

- [**GREEN**](#lxmfy.colors.Colors.GREEN) –

### `lxmfy.command`

```python

```

Shorthand decorator for creating Command instances.

- ****kwargs** – Keyword arguments to pass to Command constructor

- **Command** – A new Command instance

### `lxmfy.commands`

Command handling module for LXMFy.

This module provides the core command handling functionality for LXMFy bots,
including command registration, method decoration, and cog support.

**Classes:**

- [**Cog**](#lxmfy.commands.Cog) – Base class for bot extension modules (cogs).
- [**Command**](#lxmfy.commands.Command) – A decorator class for bot commands.
- [**CommandHelp**](#lxmfy.commands.CommandHelp) – Help metadata for a command

**Functions:**

- [**command**](#lxmfy.commands.command) – Shorthand decorator for creating Command instances.

#### `lxmfy.commands.Cog`

```python
Cog(bot)
```

Base class for bot extension modules (cogs).

Cogs are used to organize bot commands and listeners into modular components.
Each cog represents a collection of related commands and functionality.

**Attributes:**

- [**bot**](#lxmfy.commands.Cog.bot) – The bot instance that this cog is attached to

**Functions:**

- [**has_permission**](#lxmfy.commands.Cog.has_permission) – Check if user has specific permission

**Parameters:**

- **bot** – The bot instance that this cog will be registered to

##### `lxmfy.commands.Cog.bot`

```python
bot = bot
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Cog.has_permission`

```python
has_permission(user, permission)
```

Check if user has specific permission

#### `lxmfy.commands.Command`

```python
Command(name, description='No description provided', admin_only=False, permissions=None, usage=None, examples=None, category=None, aliases=None, threaded=False, rate_limit=None)
```

A decorator class for bot commands.

This class is used to mark methods as bot commands and provide metadata
about the command such as its name, description, and permission requirements.

**Attributes:**

- [**name**](#lxmfy.commands.Command.name) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the command
- [**description**](#lxmfy.commands.Command.description) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – A description of what the command does
- [**admin_only**](#lxmfy.commands.Command.admin_only) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether the command is restricted to admin users
- [**callback**](#lxmfy.commands.Command.callback) (<code>[callable](#callable)</code>) – The function that implements the command

**Parameters:**

- **name** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the command
- **description** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – Description of the command. Defaults to "No description provided"
- **admin_only** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether the command requires admin privileges. Defaults to False
- **rate_limit** (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Max invocations per sender per
cooldown window for this command. None disables the
per-command limit; the global message rate limit still
applies.

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.admin_only`

```python
admin_only = admin_only
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.callback`

```python
callback = None
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.description`

```python
description = description
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.help`

```python
help = CommandHelp(name=name, description=description, usage=usage, examples=examples or [], category=category, aliases=aliases or [])
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.name`

```python
name = name
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.permissions`

```python
permissions = permissions or (DefaultPerms.ALL if admin_only else DefaultPerms.USE_COMMANDS)
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.rate_limit`

```python
rate_limit = rate_limit
```

##### `lxmfy.commands.Command.threaded`

```python
threaded = threaded
```

#### `lxmfy.commands.CommandHelp`

- [**description**](#lxmfy.commands.CommandHelp.description) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) –

- [**name**](#lxmfy.commands.CommandHelp.name) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) –

### `lxmfy.config`

Configuration module for LXMFy.

**Classes:**

- [**BotConfig**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig) – Configuration settings for LXMFBot.

#### `lxmfy.config.BotConfig`

```python
BotConfig(name='LXMFBot', announce=600, announce_immediately=True, admins=None, hot_reloading=False, rate_limit=5, cooldown=60, max_warnings=3, warning_timeout=300, command_prefix='/', cogs_dir='cogs', cogs_enabled=True, permissions_enabled=False, storage_type='json', storage_path='data', first_message_enabled=True, event_logging_enabled=True, max_logged_events=1000, event_middleware_enabled=True, announce_enabled=True, signature_verification_enabled=False, require_message_signatures=False, require_stamps=False, request_unknown_identities=False, stamp_cost=None, include_tickets=True, direct_delivery_retries=3, propagation_fallback_enabled=True, propagation_node=None, autopeer_propagation=False, autopeer_maxdepth=4, enable_propagation_node=False, message_storage_limit_mb=500.0, config_path=None, reticulum_config_dir=None, announce_display_name_file=None, test_mode=False, log_level='INFO', loglevel=None, identity_pinning_enabled=False, message_persistence_enabled=True, message_queue_size=50, pending_sends_enabled=True, pending_sends_max=200, pending_sends_ttl=604800, pending_sends_retry=300, dynamic_cogs_enabled=True, external_cogs_enabled=True, external_cogs_sandbox_enabled=True, external_cogs_sandbox_type='auto', external_cogs_timeout=30, landlock_enabled=True, nlp_enabled=False, nlp_threshold=0.5, link_support_enabled=False, opportunistic_sending=True, lxmf_commands_enabled=True, rrc_enabled=False, rrc_hubs=None, rrc_rooms=None, rrc_nick=None, rrc_dest_name='rrc.hub', rrc_auto_reconnect=True, rrc_persist_sessions=True)
```

Configuration settings for LXMFBot.

**Attributes:**

- [**name**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.name) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The name of the bot. Defaults to "LXMFBot".
- [**announce**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.announce) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The announce interval in seconds. Defaults to 600.
- [**announce_immediately**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.announce_immediately) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to announce immediately on startup. Defaults to True.
- [**admins**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.admins) (<code>[set](#set)</code>) – A set of admin identity hashes. Defaults to an empty set.
- [**hot_reloading**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.hot_reloading) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable hot reloading of cogs. Defaults to False.
- [**rate_limit**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.rate_limit) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The maximum number of messages allowed per cooldown period. Defaults to 5.
- [**cooldown**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.cooldown) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The cooldown period in seconds. Defaults to 60.
- [**max_warnings**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.max_warnings) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The maximum number of spam warnings before action is taken. Defaults to 3.
- [**warning_timeout**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.warning_timeout) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The duration in seconds for which a spam warning is active. Defaults to 300.
- [**command_prefix**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.command_prefix) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The prefix for bot commands. Defaults to "/".
- [**cogs_dir**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.cogs_dir) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The directory to load cogs from. Defaults to "cogs".
- [**cogs_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.cogs_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable cogs. Defaults to True.
- [**permissions_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.permissions_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable the permission system. Defaults to False.
- [**storage_type**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.storage_type) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The type of storage to use ("json", "sqlite", "msgpack", or "memory"). Defaults to "json".
- [**storage_path**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.storage_path) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The path to the storage file or directory. Defaults to "data".
- [**first_message_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.first_message_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable first message handling. Defaults to True.
- [**event_logging_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.event_logging_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable event logging. Defaults to True.
- [**max_logged_events**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.max_logged_events) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – The maximum number of events to log. Defaults to 1000.
- [**event_middleware_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.event_middleware_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable event middleware. Defaults to True.
- [**announce_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.announce_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable bot announcements. Defaults to True.
- [**signature_verification_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.signature_verification_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to enable cryptographic signature verification for incoming messages. Defaults to False.
- [**require_message_signatures**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.require_message_signatures) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to reject unsigned messages when signature verification is enabled. Defaults to False.
- [**require_stamps**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.require_stamps) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to reject messages with invalid stamps. Defaults to False.
- [**request_unknown_identities**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.request_unknown_identities) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to request unknown identities from the network when a message is received from an unknown source. Defaults to False.
- [**stamp_cost**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.stamp_cost) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Stamp cost required for messages to this bot.
Outbound cost still comes from the peer announce unless send()
overrides it. None disables inbound stamps. Defaults to None.
- [**include_tickets**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.include_tickets) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Include reply tickets on outbound messages so
peers that require stamps can answer without stamp generation.
Defaults to True.
- [**direct_delivery_retries**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.direct_delivery_retries) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Number of times to retry direct delivery before falling back to propagation. Defaults to 3.
- [**propagation_fallback_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.propagation_fallback_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to use propagation nodes as fallback after direct delivery fails. Defaults to True.
- [**propagation_node**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.propagation_node) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash of the outbound propagation node. If None and autopeer_propagation is True, automatically discovers nodes. Defaults to None.
- [**autopeer_propagation**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.autopeer_propagation) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to automatically discover and peer with propagation nodes from announces. Defaults to False.
- [**autopeer_maxdepth**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.autopeer_maxdepth) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Maximum hop depth for auto-peering with propagation nodes. None = no limit. Defaults to 4.
- [**enable_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.enable_propagation_node) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to run this bot as a propagation node. Defaults to False.
- [**message_storage_limit_mb**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.message_storage_limit_mb) (<code>[float](#float)</code>) – Maximum storage for propagation node messages in megabytes. Only applies when enable_propagation_node is True. Defaults to 500 MB.
- [**config_path**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.config_path) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The path to the bot configuration directory. If None, defaults to "config" in the current working directory. Defaults to None.
- [**reticulum_config_dir**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.reticulum_config_dir) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The Reticulum config directory used for RNS shared instance/auth state. If None, uses LXMFY_RETICULUM_CONFIG_DIR when set, otherwise discovers the user/system Reticulum config (/etc/reticulum, ~/.config/reticulum, ~/.reticulum), and only then falls back to config_path. Isolated bot configs force share_instance=No to avoid RPC digest rejection with NomadNet/Columba.
- [**test_mode**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.test_mode) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Whether to run in test mode (skips RNS initialization). Defaults to False.
- [**log_level**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.log_level) (<code>[str](#str) or [int](#int) or None</code>) – Logging level for lxmfy's own logger ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", ...). None leaves logging untouched. Defaults to "INFO".
- [**loglevel**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.loglevel) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – RNS log level (0-7) passed to RNS.Reticulum. None uses the Reticulum config file setting. Defaults to None.
- [**pending_sends_enabled**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.pending_sends_enabled) (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – Hold outbound messages when the destination identity is not yet known, retrying on announces and periodic sweeps. Defaults to True.
- [**pending_sends_max**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.pending_sends_max) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Maximum deferred messages kept for unknown destinations. Oldest are dropped beyond this. Defaults to 200.
- [**pending_sends_ttl**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.pending_sends_ttl) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Seconds a deferred message is kept before being dropped. Defaults to 604800 (7 days).
- [**pending_sends_retry**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.pending_sends_retry) (<code>[int](#int)</code>) – Minimum seconds between deferred-send sweeps in run(). Defaults to 300.
- [**announce_display_name_file**](#lxmfy.config.BotConfig.announce_display_name_file) (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – Optional filename under config_path whose UTF-8 contents override the bot display name for LXMF delivery announces. If unset, ``bot_display_name.txt`` is read when present. Otherwise ``name`` is used.

### `lxmfy.conversations`

Multi-step conversations for LXMFBot.

Commands can ask a sender a question and consume their next message as the
answer instead of dispatching it as a command. Supports blocking, awaited,
and callback styles.

**Classes:**

- [**Answer**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer) – The message that answered a pending question.
- [**ConversationManager**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager) – Tracks pending questions per sender and resolves them on reply.

**Attributes:**

- [**DEFAULT_TIMEOUT**](#lxmfy.conversations.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT) – 
- [**MAX_PENDING**](#lxmfy.conversations.MAX_PENDING) – 

#### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer`

```python
Answer(sender, message, bot=None)
```

The message that answered a pending question.

**Functions:**

- [**reply**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.reply) – Reply to the sender who answered, threading to their message.

**Attributes:**

- [**content**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.content) – 
- [**fields**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.fields) – 
- [**hash**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.hash) – 
- [**message**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.message) – 
- [**sender**](#lxmfy.conversations.Answer.sender) – 

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.content`

```python
content = raw.decode('utf-8') if isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(raw)
```

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.fields`

```python
fields = getattr(message, 'fields', None) or {}
```

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.hash`

```python
hash = msg_hash.hex() if isinstance(msg_hash, (bytes, bytearray)) else None
```

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.message`

```python
message = message
```

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.reply`

```python
reply(text, **kwargs)
```

Reply to the sender who answered, threading to their message.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.Answer.sender`

```python
sender = sender
```

#### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager`

```python
ConversationManager(bot)
```

Tracks pending questions per sender and resolves them on reply.

**Functions:**

- [**ask**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask) – Send a prompt and block until the sender replies.
- [**ask_async**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask_async) – Send a prompt and await the sender's reply.
- [**ask_callback**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask_callback) – Send a prompt and invoke on_answer(answer) when the reply arrives.
- [**cancel**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.cancel) – Cancel a pending question for a sender.
- [**cancel_all**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.cancel_all) – Cancel every pending question.
- [**has_pending**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.has_pending) – True when a question is waiting on this sender.
- [**pending_count**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.pending_count) – Number of senders with a pending question.
- [**pending_senders**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.pending_senders) – Senders with a pending question.
- [**resolve**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.resolve) – Feed an inbound message to a pending question.

**Attributes:**

- [**bot**](#lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.bot) – 

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask`

```python
ask(sender, prompt, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None)
```

Send a prompt and block until the sender replies.

Returns an Answer with content, fields, and hash, or None on
timeout or cancellation. In async command handlers use
``await msg.ask_async(...)`` instead. For long waits prefer the
callback style with ``on_answer`` so no thread stays parked.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask_async`

```python
ask_async(sender, prompt, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None)
```

Send a prompt and await the sender's reply.

Same contract as ask, for async command handlers.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.ask_callback`

```python
ask_callback(sender, prompt, on_answer, *, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, title=None, validator=None, on_timeout=None)
```

Send a prompt and invoke on_answer(answer) when the reply arrives.

Non-blocking. on_timeout(sender) fires if the sender never
answers. Returns False when the pending limit is reached.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.bot`

```python
bot = bot
```

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.cancel`

```python
cancel(sender)
```

Cancel a pending question for a sender.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.cancel_all`

```python
cancel_all()
```

Cancel every pending question.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.has_pending`

```python
has_pending(sender)
```

True when a question is waiting on this sender.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.pending_count`

```python
pending_count()
```

Number of senders with a pending question.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.pending_senders`

```python
pending_senders()
```

Senders with a pending question.

##### `lxmfy.conversations.ConversationManager.resolve`

```python
resolve(sender, message)
```

Feed an inbound message to a pending question.

Returns True when the message was consumed as an answer. When a
validator rejects the answer the question stays pending.

#### `lxmfy.conversations.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`

```python
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 300.0
```

#### `lxmfy.conversations.MAX_PENDING`

```python
MAX_PENDING = 1024
```

### `lxmfy.core`

Core module for LXMFy bot framework.

This module provides the main LXMFBot class that handles message routing,
command processing, and bot lifecycle management for LXMF-based bots on
the Reticulum Network.

**Classes:**

- [**LXMFBot**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot) – Main bot class for handling LXMF messages and commands.

**Attributes:**

- [**BOT_DISPLAY_NAME_FILE**](#lxmfy.core.BOT_DISPLAY_NAME_FILE) – 

#### `lxmfy.core.BOT_DISPLAY_NAME_FILE`

```python
BOT_DISPLAY_NAME_FILE = 'bot_display_name.txt'
```

#### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot`

```python
LXMFBot(name=None, **kwargs)
```

Bases: <code>[AnnounceMixin](#lxmfy._announcing.AnnounceMixin)</code>, <code>[DispatchMixin](#lxmfy._dispatch.DispatchMixin)</code>, <code>[CogMixin](#lxmfy._cogs.CogMixin)</code>, <code>[InboundMixin](#lxmfy._inbound.InboundMixin)</code>, <code>[OutboundMixin](#lxmfy._outbound.OutboundMixin)</code>, <code>[LinkMixin](#lxmfy._links.LinkMixin)</code>, <code>[RRCMixin](#lxmfy._rrc.RRCMixin)</code>, <code>[PropagationMixin](#lxmfy._propagation.PropagationMixin)</code>

Main bot class for handling LXMF messages and commands.

This class manages the bot's lifecycle, including:
- Message routing and delivery
- Command registration and execution
- Cog (extension) loading and management
- Spam protection
- Admin privileges

**Functions:**

- [**add_cog**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.add_cog) – Add a cog to the bot.
- [**allow_control_identity**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.allow_control_identity) – Allow an identity to issue control requests to this node.
- [**allow_destination**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.allow_destination) – Add an identity to the router allow list.
- [**announce_now**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_now) – Send an LXMF delivery announce using the current display name.
- [**announce_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_propagation_node) – Announce this node as a propagation node.
- [**cancel_all_inbound**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_all_inbound) – Cancel all active inbound resource transfers.
- [**cancel_inbound**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_inbound) – Cancel an active inbound resource transfer by its hash.
- [**cancel_outbound**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_outbound) – Cancel a pending outbound message by its message_id.
- [**cancel_propagation_sync**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_propagation_sync) – Tear down an in-progress propagation node sync.
- [**cleanup**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cleanup) – Clean up resources.
- [**command**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.command) – Decorator for registering commands.
- [**connect_rrc**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.connect_rrc) – Connect to an RRC hub as a client.
- [**delivery_link_available**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.delivery_link_available) – Check whether a direct link is up for a destination.
- [**diagnose_connectivity**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.diagnose_connectivity) – Run a connectivity doctor report for this bot.
- [**diagnose_destination**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.diagnose_destination) – Probe path and identity for a destination hash.
- [**disallow_control_identity**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.disallow_control_identity) – Revoke control request access for an identity.
- [**disallow_destination**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.disallow_destination) – Remove an identity from the router allow list.
- [**disconnect_rrc**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.disconnect_rrc) – Disconnect one or all RRC hub sessions.
- [**enforce_stamps**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.enforce_stamps) – Enforce stamp requirements for inbound deliveries.
- [**generate_ticket**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.generate_ticket) – Generate an LXMF ticket that lets a destination bypass stamp costs.
- [**get_debugger**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_debugger) – Return a Debugger bound to this bot.
- [**get_inbound_tickets**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_inbound_tickets) – List valid inbound tickets held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_landlock_status**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_landlock_status) – Return Landlock LSM sandbox availability and activation state.
- [**get_outbound_progress**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_outbound_progress) – Get transfer progress (0.0-1.0) for a pending outbound LXM.
- [**get_outbound_stamp_cost**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_outbound_stamp_cost) – Get the stamp cost a destination announced it requires, or None.
- [**get_outbound_ticket**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_outbound_ticket) – Get a valid outbound ticket held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_outbound_ticket_expiry**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_outbound_ticket_expiry) – Get the expiry timestamp of the outbound ticket for a destination.
- [**get_peer_announce**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_announce) – Return announce metadata held for a destination, or None.
- [**get_peer_app_data**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_app_data) – Recall the app_data a destination last announced, or None.
- [**get_peer_lxmf_data**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_lxmf_data) – Decode an LXMF peer's announced metadata, or None.
- [**get_propagation_node_status**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_propagation_node_status) – Get information about configured and discovered propagation nodes.
- [**get_propagation_stats**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_propagation_stats) – Compile propagation node statistics.

- [**ignore_stamps**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.ignore_stamps) – Disable stamp enforcement for inbound deliveries.

- [**inbound_transfers**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.inbound_transfers) – Snapshot active inbound resource transfers.

- [**is_admin**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.is_admin) – Check if a sender is an admin.
- [**is_ignored**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.is_ignored) – Check whether inbound traffic from a destination is dropped.

- [**load_extension**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.load_extension) – Load an extension (cog) by name.
- [**on_delivery_event**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_delivery_event) – Subscribe to the outbound delivery event stream.
- [**on_first_message**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_first_message) – Decorator for registering first message handlers
- [**on_link**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_link) – Register a handler for incoming links.
- [**on_message**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_message) – Decorator for registering message handlers
- [**on_reaction**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_reaction) – Decorator for registering reaction handlers.

- [**remove_cog**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.remove_cog) – Remove a cog from the bot by its class name.
- [**request_link**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.request_link) – Request an RNS link to a destination.
- [**request_page**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.request_page) – Request a page from a destination.
- [**run**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.run) – Run the bot
- [**send_with_attachment**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.send_with_attachment) – Send a message with an attachment to a destination.
- [**set_inbound_stamp_cost**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.set_inbound_stamp_cost) – Require a proof-of-work stamp for inbound deliveries.
- [**set_message_storage_limit**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.set_message_storage_limit) – Set the message storage limit for propagation node mode.
- [**set_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.set_propagation_node) – Manually set the outbound propagation node.
- [**set_retain_on_node**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.set_retain_on_node) – Keep copies of synced messages on the propagation node.
- [**sync_propagation_node**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.sync_propagation_node) – Request stored messages from the outbound propagation node.
- [**unignore_destination**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.unignore_destination) – Stop dropping inbound traffic from a destination.
- [**unprioritise_destination**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.unprioritise_destination) – Remove a destination from the prioritised list.
- [**validate**](#lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.validate) – Run validation checks and return formatted results.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.allow_control_identity`

```python
allow_control_identity(destination)
```

Allow an identity to issue control requests to this node.

Control requests include peer sync and unpeer operations on a
propagation node. Returns False on an invalid hash.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.allow_destination`

```python
allow_destination(destination)
```

Add an identity to the router allow list.

When the allow list is non-empty, LXMF only accepts deliveries
from listed identities. Returns False on an invalid hash.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_enabled`

```python
announce_enabled = self.config.announce_enabled
```

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_now`

```python
announce_now(force=False)
```

Send an LXMF delivery announce using the current display name.

LXMF builds delivery announce app_data from the destination display name
at announce time; this method refreshes that from :attr:`name`, optional
``announce_display_name_file``, or ``bot_display_name.txt`` before
sending.

**Parameters:**

- **force** (<code>[bool](#bool)</code>) – If True, send now and skip the on-disk announce interval
throttle (still respects ``announce_enabled`` and requires a
running router). If False, behave like the periodic announce
task (honours ``announce_time`` and the throttle file).

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_propagation_node`

```python
announce_propagation_node()
```

Announce this node as a propagation node.

Returns False unless the router is running with propagation
enabled, since the announce requires the propagation destination.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.announce_time`

```python
announce_time = self.config.announce
```

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_all_inbound`

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_inbound`

```python
cancel_inbound(resource_hash)
```

Cancel an active inbound resource transfer by its hash.

The hash is available from inbound_transfers. Returns False when
no active transfer carries that hash.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.cancel_outbound`

```python
cancel_outbound(message_id)
```

Cancel a pending outbound message by its message_id.

The message_id is available from outbound_queue entries.
Returns False when no pending message carries that id.

propagation node.

```python
disallow_destination(destination)
```

Operates on the list directly because LXMRouter.disallow pops by
index in LXMF 1.1.1 and raises instead of removing the entry.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.generate_ticket`

```python
generate_ticket(destination, expiry=None)
```

Generate an LXMF ticket that lets a destination bypass stamp costs.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash the ticket is valid for.
- **expiry** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Seconds until expiry. None uses the LXMF default.

Returns a dict with expires and ticket keys, or None when a valid
ticket was recently delivered or the hash is invalid.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_announce`

```python
get_peer_announce(destination)
```

Return announce metadata held for a destination, or None.

Includes hop count, when the announce was heard, which interface
delivered it, and the announced app_data.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_app_data`

```python
get_peer_app_data(destination)
```

Recall the app_data a destination last announced, or None.

App data is whatever the announcing app attached to its announce.
LXMF delivery announces carry the peer display name; other apps
publish their own metadata.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.get_peer_lxmf_data`

```python
get_peer_lxmf_data(destination)
```

Decode an LXMF peer's announced metadata, or None.

LXMF delivery announces pack app_data as msgpack:
[display_name, stamp_cost, supported_functionality]. Returns a
dict with those keys when the peer announced a valid LXMF entry.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_delivery_event`

```python
on_delivery_event(callback=None)
```

Subscribe to the outbound delivery event stream.

Usable as bot.on_delivery_event(fn) or as a decorator
@bot.on_delivery_event(). Subscribers receive event dicts with
ts, stage (queued, deferred, dispatched, delivered, failed,
cancelled, dropped), and destination/message_id/hash/reason
fields when available.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_reaction`


carries reaction_to, reaction_emoji, and reaction_sender.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.on_rrc`

```python
on_rrc(callback=None)
```

Register a handler for RRC events.

Handler signature: ``handler(event, client, payload)``.
Payload is an RRCMessage for room events, or a dict for status/welcome.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.outbound_queue`

```python
outbound_queue()
```

Snapshot pending outbound messages.

Each entry carries hash, message_id, destination, state, and
progress so callers can feed hashes back into cancel_outbound or
get_outbound_progress.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.react`

```python
react(destination, message_hash, reaction)
```

Send a reaction to a message.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash of the message author.
- **message_hash** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The full LXMessage hash being reacted to, hex.
- **reaction** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The reaction content, usually a single emoji.

Reactions travel as an LXMF FIELD_REACTION dict on an otherwise
empty message. Clients that understand the field attach it to the
target message; clients that do not see a short empty delivery.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.reaction_handlers`

```python
reaction_handlers = []
```

- **callback** (<code>[Callable](#collections.abc.Callable) | None</code>) – Optional callback when link is established.
- **app_name** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The app name for the destination (default: "lxmf").
- ***aspects** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – Additional aspects for the destination (default: "delivery" if none provided).

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.send_with_attachment`

```python
send_with_attachment(destination, message, attachment, title='Reply', stamp_cost=None, opportunistic=None, include_ticket=None)
```

Send a message with an attachment to a destination.

**Parameters:**

- **destination** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The destination hash.
- **message** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The message content.
- **attachment** (<code>[Attachment](#lxmfy.attachments.Attachment)</code>) – The attachment to send.
- **title** (<code>[str](#str)</code>) – The message title.
- **stamp_cost** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Optional outbound stamp cost for this message.
- **opportunistic** (<code>[bool](#bool) | None</code>) – Whether to use opportunistic sending.
- **include_ticket** (<code>[bool](#bool) | None</code>) – Whether to include an LXMF reply ticket.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.set_inbound_stamp_cost`

```python
set_inbound_stamp_cost(stamp_cost)
```

Require a proof-of-work stamp for inbound deliveries.

**Parameters:**

- **stamp_cost** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Required stamp value between 1 and 254, or None
to clear the requirement.

Returns False when the bot's delivery destination is not
registered or LXMF rejects the cost.


##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.sync_propagation_node`

```python
sync_propagation_node(max_messages=None)
```

Request stored messages from the outbound propagation node.

Establishes a link to the configured propagation node if needed
and downloads messages held for this bot's identity. Delivery
completes asynchronously through the normal inbound pipeline.

**Parameters:**

- **max_messages** (<code>[int](#int) | None</code>) – Maximum messages to request. None requests all.

Returns False when no router, identity, or outbound propagation
node is configured.



##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.unignore_destination`

```python
unignore_destination(destination)
```

Stop dropping inbound traffic from a destination.

##### `lxmfy.core.LXMFBot.unprioritise_destination`

```python
unprioritise_destination(destination)
```

Remove a destination from the prioritised list.

Operates on the list directly because LXMRouter.unprioritise in
LXMF 1.1.1 references an unbound name and always fails.

